events.title: Kaikoura flight lights observed on southbound cargo run
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Pilot Captain Bill Startup, co-pilot Robert Guard, reporter Quentin Fogarty, and a film crew aboard the Argosy freighter; Wellington ATC also reported radar targets.

**Sighting:** On a southbound flight from Blenheim to Christchurch and back, lights were first seen in the Kaikoura direction, from just southeast of Cape Campbell, and later tracked as the aircraft continued south.

**Object:** Multiple anomalous bright lights, sometimes appearing in the 12:00 to 3:00 position relative to the aircraft, with one seen off the right wing after the plane passed Kaikoura.

**Tactics:** The aircraft did not use its radar on the southbound leg, but ATC reported nearby targets at roughly the same time.

**Note:** This page summarizes the event on 30 Dec 1978 and is part of the Kaikoura lights case.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 阿戈西货机上的飞行员 Bill Startup、副驾驶 Robert Guard、记者 Quentin Fogarty，以及摄制组；惠灵顿空管也报告了雷达目标。

**目击经过：** 这架飞机从布伦海姆飞往基督城再折返途中，首先在自 Cape Campbell 东南偏南方向、面向凯库拉的方位看到灯光，随后在飞机继续向南飞行时仍持续出现。

**物体：** 多个异常明亮的光点，有时位于飞机前方偏左到偏右的 12 点至 3 点方向，其中一个在飞机经过凯库拉后出现在右机翼外侧。

**战术：** 该机南下航段未使用机载雷达，但空管在同一时间段报告了附近目标。

**注：** 本页是在 1978-12-30 对该事件的摘要，属于凯库拉灯光事件的一部分。

events.title: Bright yellow-white/orange light seen on Christchurch-to-Blenheim flight
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** The pilot, co-pilot, and cameraman aboard the flight north, later joined by two reporters, all observed the object.

**Sighting:** About 3 minutes after departure from Christchurch on the flight to Blenheim, while climbing through a low cloud cover, they saw a bright yellow/white/orange light at roughly their level.

**Object:** It appeared and disappeared through the cloud tops and was estimated to be 10–30 degrees to the right of the aircraft, which was heading northeast.

**Tactics:** The page also notes earlier Wellington ATC/Radar tracking of a target near the Kaikoura East reporting point behind the aircraft, suggesting the light was associated with the same Kaikoura-area event.

**Note:** This is a page from a longer Kaikoura incident narrative; the described observation is concrete and dated, but the exact ground position is only approximate.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 机上飞行员、副驾驶和摄像师，后来返程航班上的两名记者也看到了该物体。

**目击：** 飞机于从基督城起飞前往布莱尼姆后约 3 分钟，在穿越低云层上升时，他们看见一个明亮的黄/白/橙色光点，距离大致与飞机同高。

**物体：** 该光点会在云层顶部之间时隐时现，估计位于飞机右侧 10 至 30 度之间，而飞机当时正朝东北飞行。

**动向：** 本页还提到惠灵顿塔台/雷达曾在 Kaikoura East 报告点附近跟踪到一个目标，显示这可能与同一 Kaikoura 地区事件有关。

**注：** 这是更长篇 Kaikoura 事件叙述中的一页；所述观察具有明确日期，但地面位置只能近似确定。

events.title: Kaikoura flight event timeline and radar contact
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Aboard the aircraft were the pilot Captain William Startup, first officer Robert Guard, TV crew members David and Ngaire Crockett, reporter Quentin Fogarty, and at times radar staff Geoffrey Causer and Bryan Chalmers monitoring the flight.

**Sighting:** This page lists the event sequence for the Kaikoura trip south. At about 23:54 on 30 Dec 1978 the plane took off and circled southward over Wellington; shortly after midnight on 31 Dec it passed Cape Campbell while the crew was working on a stand-up for the earlier UFO story.

**Object:** The page does not describe a new luminous object directly, but documents the flight position, radar monitoring, and the area where the earlier lights had been first spotted.

**Tactics:** Wellington radar was queried about targets in the direction of the Kaikoura Peninsula, and the aircraft was tracked as an “entity” on radar.

**Note:** This is an event-log page connected to the Kaikoura UFO case rather than a standalone witness statement.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 机上有飞行员 William Startup 船长、二副 Robert Guard、摄像师 David Crockett、录音师 Ngaire Crockett、记者 Quentin Fogarty；同时还有塔台/雷达人员 Geoffrey Causer、Bryan Chalmers 以及雷达操作员 BC 参与监测。

**目击经过：** 本页列出了 Kaikoura 航程南下的事件时间线。1978 年 12 月 30 日约 23:54，飞机起飞并在惠灵顿上空盘旋后向南飞行；翌日 12 月 31 日午夜后不久，飞机经过 Cape Campbell，当时机组正在为先前的 UFO 新闻做现场连线。

**物体：** 本页并未直接描述新的发光物体，而是记录了飞行位置、雷达监控，以及先前灯光最初被发现的大致区域。

**策略：** 机组向惠灵顿雷达询问 Kaikoura 半岛方向是否有目标，飞机也在雷达上作为一个“实体”被跟踪。

**注：** 这是一页与 Kaikoura UFO 案件相关的事件日志，而不是独立的目击陈述。

events.title: Wellington radar targets tracked overnight
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Wellington radar staff, including Geoffrey Causer, the previous controller, GC, Senior Controller John Cordy, and controller Andy Herd.

**Sighting:** Radar picked up anomalous targets repeatedly from about 11:45 PM on Dec. 30 until about 4:00 AM on Dec. 31, with related targets also reported during the early hours of Dec. 21.

**Object:** The targets generally did not leave trails, sometimes appeared only for one sweep, and at other times remained fixed for many sweeps; one target seemed to pace an aircraft and another moved northward from south of Cape Campbell, later disappearing off scope after showing an apparent speed of about 60 knots.

**Tactics:** The targets appeared, vanished, and reappeared, sometimes holding position and sometimes leaving a continuous trail on radar.

**Note:** This page is an analysis of the radar returns, not a first-hand narrative, but it describes a concrete radar-visual UFO/UAP event in the Wellington area.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 惠灵顿雷达值班人员，包括 Geoffrey Causer、前一班值班员、GC、首席管制员 John Cordy，以及管制员 Andy Herd。

**目击：** 雷达从 12 月 30 日晚约 11:45 一直记录到 12 月 31 日凌晨约 4:00 的异常目标；文中也提到 12 月 21 日凌晨早些时候的相关目标。

**物体：** 这些目标通常不留下尾迹，有时只出现一圈扫描，有时又会在多个扫描中保持固定位置；其中一个目标似乎在伴随一架飞机飞行，另一个则从 Cape Campbell 以南向北移动，随后消失在雷达屏幕外，表观速度约 60 节。

**行为：** 目标会出现、消失、再出现，有时保持不动，有时在雷达上形成连续轨迹。

**备注：** 这页是对雷达回波的分析，而不是第一手叙述，但它确实描述了惠灵顿地区一次具体的 UFO/UAP 雷达目击事件。

events.title: Radar-tracked UFO near Waverley heading toward vessels
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** An air traffic controller at Air Staff relayed a report from the duty supervisor, and RNZAF radar personnel at nearby sites were involved.

**Sighting:** Around 2240 hours, radar on both VN and DH picked up an unidentified flying object near the coast.

**Object:** It crossed the coast near Waverley and appeared to head toward three vessels off the Wanganui coast. The pilot later reported seeing the three vessels but no aircraft/UFO.

**Tactics:** The target passed a short distance from the radar target without making any visible or radar-obvious evasive move; it then proceeded on a westward track and descended from about 60,000 ft to 30–45,000 ft intermittently.

**Note:** The report notes the police had been advised, in case it involved a secret or military operation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 空中交通管制员向总部转述了值班主管的报告，且附近站点的 RNZAF 雷达人员也参与了观测。

**目击情况：** 约 2240 时，两部雷达（VN 和 DH）都探测到一个不明飞行物，位置在海岸附近。

**物体：** 它越过 Waverley 附近海岸，似乎朝着旺加努伊海岸外的三艘船只飞去。随后飞行员报告看到了这三艘船，但没有看到飞机/UFO。

**行为：** 目标从雷达目标附近经过，未见明显机动；之后向西飞行，并间歇性地从约 6 万英尺下降到 3–4.5 万英尺。

**备注：** 报告称已通知警方，以防这涉及秘密或军事行动。

events.title: TV1 film of suspected UFO over Clarence River area
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A Television One camera crew filmed the event.

**Sighting:** On 3 January 1979, cine film of a suspected "UFO" was taken in the Clarence River area.

**Object:** The page does not describe the object's shape or behavior in detail; it refers to selected frames from the film being analyzed.

**Tactics:** Computer image processing techniques were used to examine the footage in a Physics and Engineering Laboratory report.

**Note:** This is a report abstract about the filmed sighting, not the original incident narrative.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一组 Television One 摄制组记录了该事件。

**目击：** 1979年1月3日，在 Clarence River 地区拍摄到一段疑似“UFO”的电影胶片。

**物体：** 该页未详细描述物体的形状或行为，只提到对影片中的若干画面进行了分析。

**方法：** 物理与工程实验室报告中使用了计算机图像处理技术来检视这段影像。

**注：** 这是一份关于该目击影像的报告摘要，并非最初事件的现场叙述。

events.location: Clarence River area north of Kaikoura, NZ
events.title: TV crew filmed bright light near Clarence River north of Kaikoura
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: Clarence River area north of Kaikoura, NZ
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A Television One camera crew was filming in the Clarence River area north of Kaikoura.

**Sighting:** Early on the morning of 3 January 1979 they captured cine film of a bright light in the night sky.

**Object:** The page describes the object only as a suspected “unidentified flying object,” seen as a bright light and later analysed because the film appeared blurred.

**Tactics:** The film was submitted for computer image processing and deblurring by the Remote Sensing Section of the Physics and Engineering Laboratory.

**Note:** This page is the introduction to a technical analysis report, but it clearly references a concrete sighting event with date, location, witness, and observation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** Television One（TV1）摄制组当时在凯库拉（Kaikoura）以北的克拉伦斯河（Clarence River）地区拍摄。

**目击：** 1979年1月3日清晨，他们拍到夜空中一个明亮光点的电影胶片。

**对象：** 页面将其描述为疑似“未确认飞行物”（UFO），仅呈现为一个明亮光点；由于胶片看似模糊，后来被拿去分析。

**手法：** 胶片交由物理与工程实验室的遥感部门进行电脑影像处理与去模糊。

**注：** 这页是技术分析报告的引言，但明确对应一个具体的目击事件，具备日期、地点、目击者和观测内容。

events.title: Radar contact off Clarence River, observed by Wellington ATC
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Reg Phillips of Wellington ATC, reporting a contact seen on radar.

**Sighting:** At about 2105 NZDT on 8 Feb 1979, a solid radar contact was observed off the Clarence River area and was still being tracked at 2125.

**Object:** The contact was reported maintaining a left-hand triangular pattern at about 80 knots, then calculated to be advancing on an MLA of roughly 140/10 knots after 40 minutes.

**Tactics:** An ANZ B737 was directed through the area, and a Cessna 402 was in and out of stratus at 15,000 ft; neither aircraft saw anything.

**Note:** This is a radar-only incident, recorded in a minute sheet titled “Unidentified Radar Contact.”
events.report_summary_zh:
**Witness:** 惠灵顿空中交通管制员 Reg Phillips，通过雷达通报一个稳定的目标。

**Sighting:** 1979年2月8日约2105（NZDT），在 Clarence River 一带外海发现一个稳定的雷达回波，并持续跟踪到2125。

**Object:** 该目标据报以约80节保持左转三角形航迹，40分钟后推算其正以约140/10节的速度推进到一个 MLA。

**Tactics:** 一架 ANZ B737 被引导穿过该区域，一架 Cessna 402 在15000英尺云层中进出，但两者都未见异常。

**Note:** 这是一次仅靠雷达记录的事件，文件标题为“Unidentified Radar Contact”。

events.location: 28 NM east of Waimakariri, Canterbury, NZ
events.title: Night helicopter sighting off Waimakariri with radar contact
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.official_location: 28 NM east of Waimakariri, Canterbury, NZ
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Crew of a vessel operating about 28 nautical miles east of Waimakariri (Canterbury) reported the incident; the note also refers to a large vessel in the vicinity.

**Sighting:** A helicopter was first detected on radar at about 1.5 nm, then visually observed on several occasions at night.

**Object:** It was seen as a helicopter-like light source, at times almost hovering, with a white light beneath it that seemed to move vertically; it later disappeared to the north/northeast. A small grey ship with no or very poor lighting was also noted nearby.

**Tactics:** The helicopter was tracked by radar and by visual observation.

**Note:** This appears to be a maritime night-incident summary rather than a classic unknown craft report, but it describes a concrete sighting event.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一艘船上的船员报告了这起事件；备注中还提到附近还有一艘大型船只。

**目击经过：** 在坎特伯雷怀马卡里里（Waimakariri）以东约 28 海里处，雷达先在约 1.5 海里距离上捕捉到一架直升机，随后在夜间又被多次目视观察。

**目标：** 它看起来像一架直升机，时而几乎悬停；机下有一道白光，似乎带有上下垂直移动，随后向北/东北方向消失。附近还观察到一艘没有灯光或灯光很弱的小灰船。

**策略：** 该目标曾被雷达跟踪，也被目视观察。

**备注：** 这更像一份海上夜间事件摘要，而不是典型的“未知飞行物”报告，但它描述了一个具体的目击事件。

events.title: Photographic bright object on SAFE AIR Argosy flight
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Wellington photographer Mr David Crockett, whose film was later broadcast on TV1.

**Sighting:** On the night of 31 December 1978, a film taken from a SAFE AIR Argosy aircraft showed a bright object.

**Object:** The image appeared as a luminous shape with horizontal streaks; the page notes it may have been caused by reflections in the aircraft window or by slight defocus.

**Tactics:** The author begins a technical investigation, using a telescope and window tests at Woodbourne to check for optical artifacts.

**Note:** This page is an introduction to the analysis of the photograph rather than a full incident report, but it identifies a specific date, witness, and observed image.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 惠灵顿摄影师 David Crockett，其胶片后来在 TV1 播出。

**目击：** 1978年12月31日晚，从一架 SAFE AIR Argosy 飞机上拍摄的胶片中出现了一个明亮物体。

**物体：** 图像呈发光形状并带有水平条纹；页面指出这可能是飞机窗户反射或轻微失焦造成的。

**手法：** 作者开始进行技术性调查，在 Woodbourne 用望远镜和机窗测试来检查是否为光学伪影。

**备注：** 这一页是对照片的分析引言，而非完整事件报告，但它确实给出了具体日期、目击者和所见影像。

events.title: Bright object photographed from Argosy aircraft
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Wellington photographer Mr David Crockett.

**Sighting:** On the night of 31 December 1978, while aboard a SAFE AIR Argosy aircraft, he photographed a bright object for a Melbourne TV channel. The image was later screened on TV1 on 2 January 1979.

**Object:** A bright light/shape appearing in the photograph; the printed image showed horizontal streaks and a possible structured form.

**Tactics:** The page is part of an investigation testing whether the image could be explained by aircraft-window defects and optical artifacts, including astigmatism and defocus.

**Note:** The writer’s preliminary conclusion was that the streaks were probably artifacts produced by imperfections in the aircraft window, rather than a genuine unknown object.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 惠灵顿摄影师 David Crockett。

**目击经过：** 1978年12月31日晚，他在一架 SAFE AIR Argosy 飞机上拍摄到一个明亮物体，照片是为墨尔本一家电视台拍摄的。该影像后来于1979年1月2日在 TV1 播出。

**物体：** 照片中出现的明亮光点/形状；冲印图像呈现出水平条纹，并似乎带有一定结构。

**手法：** 本页属于调查分析，测试该图像是否可由飞机舷窗缺陷和光学伪影解释，包括散光与失焦。

**备注：** 作者初步判断，这些条纹很可能是由飞机窗户的不完美造成的伪影，而不是真正的未知飞行物。

events.title: Canterbury Coast UFO observations near Kaikoura
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A coordinated observing team operated from three sites on the Canterbury coast near Kaikoura, including Trig Station near the Met Office, Kaikoura; DSIR Magnetic Radio Station at Clarence River Mouth; and the Kaikoura Peninsula/Waipapa Point area.

**Sighting:** On the nights of 5/6 and 7/8 January 1979 they made visual observations of objects whose azimuth and elevation were measured to determine position.

**Object:** The page does not identify a confirmed craft; it refers to objects interpreted as UFOs and later notes a star-like object whose apparent motion was affected by ship heat shimmer and nearby cloud.

**Tactics:** Observations were cross-checked between stations using theodolite, magnetic compass, inclinometer, stars, and VHF coordination.

**Note:** This page is an analysis/report page tied to the Kaikoura observations rather than a casual eyewitness note.
events.report_summary_zh:
**Witness:** 一支协调观测组在凯库拉（Kaikoura）附近的坎特伯雷海岸三个地点进行观测，包括凯库拉气象局附近的三角测量站、Clarence River Mouth 的 DSIR 磁无线电站，以及凯库拉半岛/Waipapa Point 一带。

**Sighting:** 在 1979 年 1 月 5/6 日和 7/8 日夜间，他们对被认为是 UFO 的物体进行了目视观测，并测量其方位角与高度角以判断位置。

**Object:** 该页并未确认具体飞行器；文本只是提到疑似 UFO 的物体，随后还记录到一个类似恒星的目标，其表观运动受船只热扰动和附近云层影响。

**Tactics:** 观测通过经纬仪、磁罗盘、倾角仪、恒星校准以及 VHF 通联在各站之间交叉核对。

**Note:** 这是一页关于凯库拉观测的分析/报告页面，而不是普通的个人目击记录。

events.title: Wellington radar spurious echoes near Waipapa Point
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** W. Ireland and Wellington radar personnel, with supporting checks from observing sites near Waipapa Point.

**Sighting:** On the night of 7/8 January 1979, a large number of radar “echoes” were seen and assessed alongside optical observations in light westerly conditions with a low-level temperature inversion.

**Object:** The apparent targets were not physical craft; the page concludes they were spurious radar echoes, with no corresponding objects seen on radar/visual comparison.

**Tactics:** Some echoes appeared almost “overhead” or in groups, but nothing matched 18 different echo groups; the page notes ducting and temperature/humidity gradients as the likely cause.

**Note:** The author explicitly says the conditions were not appropriate to produce star/planet effects and that this was a radar anomaly, not a true UFO.
events.report_summary_zh:
**證人：** W. Ireland 以及威靈頓雷達人員，並參考瓦伊帕帕角附近觀測點的比對。

**目擊：** 1979年1月7/8日夜間，在微弱西風與近地面逆溫層條件下，觀測到大量雷達「回波」，並與目視資料一起評估。

**物體：** 這些目標並非實體飛行器；頁面結論認為它們是虛假的雷達回波，未找到相應的真實物體。

**手法：** 部分回波看似幾乎在「頭頂」上方或成群出現，但與18組不同回波都無法對應；文中指出波導效應以及溫度／濕度梯度可能是原因。

**備註：** 作者明確表示，這些條件不適合造成恆星或行星的誤判，這是一宗雷達異常，而不是真正的 UFO。

events.title: Hawkins Hill radar returns near Kaikoura-Cape Campbell
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** W. Ireland recorded observations on the Hawkins Hill 50 cm radar and consulted John Cordy, who compared the returns with display/video.

**Sighting:** On the early morning of 8 Jan 1979, multiple anomalous radar returns were tracked over several hours, with most activity off the Kaikoura-Cape Campbell coast and some over Cook Strait and Marlborough.

**Object:** The returns appeared as “unidentified” moving echoes, including spotty and persistent groups, some interpreted as ships or rain but not fully explained.

**Tactics:** The echoes often appeared suddenly, sometimes moved northward or radially outward, and in one case disappeared quickly around 0445.

**Note:** This is a radar-observation summary rather than a visual UFO report, but it documents a concrete unexplained event on a specific date and area.
events.report_summary_zh:
**证人：** W. Ireland 在 Hawkins Hill 的 50 厘米雷达上记录了观测，并与 John Cordy 核对，他对显示与录像进行了比对。

**目击：** 1979年1月8日凌晨，雷达上持续数小时出现多组异常回波，主要在 Kaikoura–Cape Campbell 海岸外，也出现在库克海峡和马尔堡地区。

**物体：** 这些回波表现为“未识别”的移动目标，包括零散和持续成群的点状回波；其中一些被解释为船只或雨，但仍未得到完全说明。

**行为：** 回波常突然出现，有时向北移动或径向向外扩散；其中一例在约0445迅速消失。

**注：** 这是一份雷达观测总结，而不是直接的目视 UFO 报告，但它确实记录了一个发生在特定日期和区域的具体未解事件。

events.title: SAFE Argosy crew reports lights near Clarence River mouth
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A SAFE Argosy captain and crew flying between Woodbourne and Christchurch, with a second crew on a later Woodbourne sortie.

**Sighting:** On the southbound leg, Wellington ATC asked the aircraft to check the Clarence River mouth area because radar returns were appearing there. The crew saw lights at low level off the Clarence River mouth, then as the aircraft moved south the lights seemed to go out or disappear. Later, on the northbound leg, the crew again saw lights in the same vicinity.

**Object:** Multiple lights over sea and shore, appearing in rectangular patterns at irregular frequency; one light briefly illuminated the water and aircraft captain, with an apparent beam rather than a point source.

**Tactics:** Lights were seen by both aircraft crews and were also reported to resemble activity seen on Wellington radar.

**Note:** The report speculates the lights may have been aircraft, cars/trains near the coast, or even helicopters, but notes no confirmation from police or locals.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一架 SAFE Argosy 客机的机长和机组，以及随后另一架 SAFE Argosy 的机组对该区域进行了复查。

**目击：** 在由伍德伯恩飞往基督城的南向航段上，惠灵顿空管因在克拉伦斯河口附近出现雷达回波，要求飞机前往查看。机组看到河口外低空有灯光；当飞机继续向南时，灯光似乎熄灭或消失。随后在北向航段上，机组又在同一地区看到了灯光。

**物体：** 多个海面与陆地上方的灯光，呈不规则频率的矩形排列；其中一道灯光短暂照亮了水面和机长，似乎更像一道光束而不是一个点光源。

**行为：** 两个航班机组都看到了该现象，且与惠灵顿雷达上的异常回波相对应。

**备注：** 报告推测这些灯可能是飞机、靠近海岸的汽车/火车，甚至是直升机，但警方和当地居民均未提供证实。

events.title: RNZAF Woodbourne lights sighting
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Orderly Officer and Duty Air Traffic Controller at RNZAF Woodbourne.

**Sighting:** Around 2350 on 20/21 Dec 1973, the officer saw three to four lights from Woodbourne, then checked them through binoculars.

**Object:** The lights appeared to be moving toward Wellington; one of the middle lights showed a white beam pointing northward.

**Tactics:** No aircraft was heard, and the lights did not appear to get any closer before they moved upward and around.

**Note:** This page is a continuation of a list of observations and includes other unrelated radar/light reports above it.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** RNZAF Woodbourne 的值班军官和值班空中交通管制员。

**目击：** 1973年12月20/21日约2350时，该军官看到从 Woodbourne 方向有三到四个灯光，并用双筒望远镜进行了观察。

**物体：** 这些灯光似乎正朝惠灵顿方向移动，其中中间一个灯光显示出一束朝北的白色光束。

**战术：** 没有听到飞机声音，灯光也未显得更接近，随后向上并向旁边移动。

**注：** 这一页是若干观测记录的续页，上方还包含其他无关的雷达/灯光报告。

events.title: Woodbourne lights observed near Cape Campbell bearing
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A Woodbourne observer, with the Duty Air Traffic Controller also seeing the same lights from the tower balcony.

**Sighting:** The lights were watched for about 50 minutes on the night of 20/21 Dec 1978, with a bearing from Woodbourne of about 080° (M), toward Cape Campbell.

**Object:** The display appeared as one bright orange light and two less intense white lights; a larger light seemed stationary while the other two moved north, with a shaft of light periodically beaming downward from the white lights.

**Tactics:** The lights at times seemed to move in a rectangular pattern at random speed, then “rush forward” and generally fade over the period.

**Note:** The observer considered the lights too distant to judge size; the report also notes no convincing radar correlation and suggests the visual and radar returns were likely unrelated.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** Woodbourne 的一名观察员，以及同样从塔台阳台看到这些灯光的值班空中交通管制员。

**目击：** 1978年12月20/21日夜间，这些灯光被持续观察了约50分钟；从 Woodbourne 方向看，方位约为080°（磁方位），指向 Cape Campbell。

**物体：** 现象看起来像一团明亮的橙色灯光和两团较弱的白色灯光；较大的光点似乎保持静止，而另外两个向北移动，白色灯光还会不时向下投射一道光束。

**机动：** 这些灯光有时似乎以随机速度作矩形移动，随后“向前冲”一下，并在整个过程中逐渐变淡。

**备注：** 观察员认为距离太远，无法判断物体大小；报告还指出雷达回波并无令人信服的对应关系，视觉目击与雷达回波很可能无关。

events.title: Hand-drawn observation chart of aircraft/radar contacts near Invercargill
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** The page is annotated as “Dods report dated 11 Jan 79” and appears to summarize observations made by Dods and associated air/radar observers.

**Sighting:** A hand-drawn map plots a sequence of events over 30/31 Dec 1978, with tracks and time marks around the South Island, including the Invercargill area.

**Object:** The diagram shows one or more unidentified lights/contacts being followed by aircraft and radar returns; the notes mention “radar returns” and “target” rather than a clearly identified conventional aircraft.

**Tactics:** The sketch indicates aircraft turning, observing, and attempting to maintain contact while radar intermittently tracks the object.

**Note:** This page is a schematic/summary chart rather than a full narrative, but it does document a concrete dated observation sequence.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** 该页标注为“Dods report dated 11 Jan 79”，看起来是在总结 Dods 及相关空中/雷达观察者在场的观测。

**目击：** 这是一张手绘地图，按 1978 年 12 月 30/31 日的时间顺序记录了南岛一带的事件，包括因弗卡吉尔（Invercargill）附近。

**物体：** 图中显示一个或多个不明灯光/目标，被飞机和雷达回波追踪；注释提到“radar returns”和“target”，但未明确识别为普通航空器。

**战术：** 草图显示飞机不断转向、观察，并尝试保持接触，而雷达时有时无地追踪该目标。

**注：** 这一页是示意图/总结图而非完整叙述，但确实记录了一个具体、带日期的观测序列。

events.title: Hawkins Hill radar anomalies over Wellington and Kaikoura coast
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** W. Ireland, on watch with John Cardy at the Wellington Control Centre, reviewing Hawkins Hill radar returns.

**Sighting:** On the early morning of 8 Jan 1979, several anomalous radar echoes were seen on 50 cm Hawkins Hill radar, with returns appearing at different times and places around the Wellington–Kaikoura–Marlborough area.

**Object:** The echoes were described as aircraft-like or as a group of three spots; some moved northwards, one moved radially outward at an erratic 100–150 knots for 10–15 minutes, and others appeared briefly before disappearing.

**Tactics:** The returns showed short-lived appearances, variable movement, and occasional tracks that could not be confidently identified; some were initially thought to be rain or afterglow effects.

**Note:** This page is a radar-observation report rather than a visual sighting, but it documents a concrete UAP-related event.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** W. Ireland 在惠灵顿控制中心值班，并与 John Cardy 一起查看 Hawkins Hill 雷达回波。

**目击：** 1979年1月8日凌晨，50厘米 Hawkins Hill 雷达上出现多次异常回波，位置遍及惠灵顿—凯库拉—马尔伯勒一带。

**物体：** 这些回波被描述为类似飞机回波，或由三个亮点组成；有的向北移动，有的以不规则的 100–150 节径向外移并持续 10–15 分钟，另一些则短暂出现后消失。

**行为：** 回波出现时间短、运动方式多变，且有些轨迹无法可靠识别；起初有人认为可能是雨回波或余辉效应。

**注：** 这页是雷达观测报告，不是目视目击，但它记录了一个具体的 UAP 事件。

events.title: SAFE Argosy aircrew reports lights and radar contacts near Kaikoura
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Captain W. Startup and First Officer Guard aboard a SAFE Argosy freight flight from Wellington to Christchurch.

**Sighting:** During the southbound leg they observed several unusual lights near the Kaikoura coast, with Kaikoura visible in the background. The crew also checked with Wellington ATC about radar returns in the area.

**Object:** A pulsing white light, a helicopter-like light moving toward the beach north of the Kaikoura peninsula, and other lights seen near Sugar Loaf Hill; some were reportedly echoed by radar blips.

**Tactics:** The crew asked ATC for radar confirmation, made orbits to investigate, and compared visual observations with radar plots.

**Note:** The page is an interview summary covering several related observations on the same flight, not a single isolated sighting.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** SAFE Argosy 货运航班上的 W. Startup 船长与副驾驶 Guard。

**目击情况：** 在惠灵顿飞往基督城的南向航段中，他们在凯库拉海岸附近看见了数个异常灯光，凯库拉当时位于背景中。机组还向惠灵顿空管询问该区域是否有雷达回波。

**物体：** 包括一个脉冲式白光、一个看似直升机般的灯光向凯库拉半岛北侧海滩移动，以及在 Sugar Loaf Hill 附近看到的其他灯光；其中一些据称也在雷达上显示为回波。

**战术：** 机组向空管求证雷达回波，并盘旋进行检查，将目视观察与雷达图像进行对照。

**注：** 这一页是同一次航班上的多起相关观察的访谈摘要，并非单一独立事件。

events.title: Kaikoura area UFO map with orange lights and aircraft track
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Hand-drawn map annotations reference observations near Kaikoura and the fishing fleet, with an aircraft track marked "CH 0216" and a note signed by "Capt. Bill Stewart / to the Bob Grand".

**Sighting:** The page plots the event over the Kaikoura coast and Cook Strait area, with notes about "orange lights" and lights seen moving around/across the sound.

**Object:** The object(s) are described as orange and/or blue lights, appearing near the surface and then moving or changing position relative to the aircraft and coast.

**Tactics:** Notes suggest repeated returns and movement around the area, with a flight path drawn to show where the lights were observed.

**Note:** This is a location map page rather than a full narrative report, but it clearly relates to a specific Kaikoura UFO sighting incident dated 30/31 Dec 1978.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** 手绘地图注释提到凯库拉（Kaikoura）附近的观察以及渔船船队，并标出了飞机航迹“CH 0216”，页末还有“Capt. Bill Stewart / to the Bob Grand”的签注。

**目击：** 该页在凯库拉海岸与库克海峡一带作图，注记写到“orange lights（橙色灯光）”以及在海湾/海峡上方移动的灯光。

**物体：** 这些物体被描述为橙色和/或蓝色灯光，似乎贴近水面出现，随后相对于飞机和海岸发生移动或位置变化。

**行为：** 注释暗示灯光多次返回并在区域内移动，图中也画出了飞机航线以说明目击位置。

**备注：** 这是一页位置示意图而不是完整叙述报告，但它明确对应于1978年12月30/31日凯库拉的一起具体UFO目击事件。

events.title: Kaikoura East flight route and lights observation
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Capt. Bill Startup and Cpl. Bob Grand.

**Sighting:** A plotted flight track shows an observation made east of Kaikoura during the night of 30/31 Dec 1978 (GMT).

**Object:** Several lights were seen, including a “light sighted over KI” and another note of “war radar targets” near an occasional cluster of lights; the annotations suggest multiple luminous objects or returns near the coast and over the sea.

**Tactics:** The page is a hand-drawn map of the aircraft’s route with arrows, bearings, and altitude notes (e.g. “approx 10,000’ M.C.C.”), indicating the witnesses tracked the objects while flying east of Kaikoura.

**Note:** This is a concrete sighting record, not a cover sheet or editorial page, though the details are sparse and partly diagrammatic.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** Capt. Bill Startup 和 Cpl. Bob Grand。

**目击：** 这是一张手绘航迹图，记录了 1978 年 12 月 30/31 日（GMT）夜间在 Kaikoura 东侧发生的一次观察。

**物体：** 图上标注了数处灯光，包括“light sighted over KI”以及“war radar targets”附近偶尔出现的一簇灯光；注记暗示在海岸外和海面上方出现了多个发光目标或回波。

**战术：** 页面以飞机航线图形式绘制，带有箭头、方位和高度标注（如“approx 10,000’ M.C.C.”），显示目击者在 Kaikoura 东侧飞行时对这些物体进行了跟踪。

**注：** 这是一个具体的目击记录，而非封面或编辑页；但细节较少，而且主要是图示性质。

events.title: Captain Randle’s aircraft encounter near Clarence River and Kaikoura
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Captain J. Randle, captain of a SAFE Argosy freight flight, with the aircraft crew.

**Sighting:** On the south-bound leg from Woodbourne to Christchurch, he saw at about midnight two vehicle-like lights moving north over rough terrain toward Cape Campbell. Later, near 0159 and again around 0406 on the return leg, radar and visual checks were made near the Clarence River area and east of Kaikoura.

**Object:** A set of lights forming a rectangular pattern at irregular intervals, seemingly at low altitude; one light appeared to illuminate the surface, and a large radar return was also noted offshore.

**Tactics:** The lights appeared to “turn away” rather than switch off, and the radar return was only seen on Clarence radar.

**Note:** The interview summary says Randle produced flight notes and later comments/speculation about the incident.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** SAFE Argosy 货运机机长 J. Randle 以及机组人员。

**目击：** 在从 Woodbourne 飞往 Christchurch 的南向航段，约午夜时他看见两个像车辆灯光的亮点，沿崎岖地形向北、朝 Cape Campbell 方向移动。随后在 0159 左右以及返航时 0406 左右，又在 Clarence River 地区和 Kaikoura 以东进行了雷达与目视检查。

**物体：** 一组呈矩形排列、以不规则间隔出现的灯光，似乎处于低空；其中一盏灯似乎照亮了地面，同时还观察到一个大型海上雷达回波。

**战术：** 这些灯光看起来像是“转身离开”而不是熄灭，而且该雷达回波只在 Clarence 雷达上出现。

**备注：** 摘要称 Randle 提供了飞行笔记以及后来对事件的评论/推测。

events.title: Safe Argosy flight reports lights and radar returns en route
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Captain J. Randle recorded notes from a Safe Argosy flight, with the first officer also noting some light sources.

**Sighting:** On the south-bound leg, lights were seen close to shore and matched Wellington radar returns; later near Gore Bay, about seven miles off the coast, an aircraft radar return was followed by lights corresponding to a fair-size ship.

**Object:** Several light groups were described, including two defined radar returns around Christchurch, with a centre target that appeared like a large ship with floodlit decks; on the north-bound return, no unusual lights were seen beyond known ships.

**Tactics:** The lights were often non-continuous and sometimes seemed directional rather than point sources; possible explanations mentioned included ships, Venus, sea/cloud reflections, and lighting effects.

**Note:** The report is an in-flight observational note rather than a formal investigation, but it documents a concrete sighting episode on a specific date and route.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** J. Randle 船长记录了 Safe Argosy 航班的笔记，副驾驶也看到了其中一些光源。

**目击：** 在南行航段，机组在靠近海岸处看到灯光，并与惠灵顿雷达回波相对应；随后在 Gore Bay 附近、距海岸约七英里处，飞机雷达出现回波，之后看到与一艘中型船只相符的灯光。

**物体：** 文中描述了几组灯光，其中在基督城附近有两个清晰的雷达回波，中心目标看起来像一艘带有泛光甲板的大船；北返时除已知船只外未见异常灯光。

**战术：** 这些灯光往往不是连续出现，有时似乎具有方向性，而不是单一光点；文中提到的可能解释包括船只、金星、海面/云层反射以及灯光效应。

**备注：** 这是一份航班中的观察笔记，而非正式调查报告，但它记录了一个具有明确日期与航线的具体目击事件。

events.title: Three lights seen near Woodbourne/Blenheim airfield
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** W/O Uffindell and Mr Frame, on duty at Woodbourne Orderly Officer / Flight Service on the night of 20/21 Dec 1978.

**Sighting:** Around 2350, Uffindell saw three lights near Woodbourne, initially thought to be a Bristol Freighter about 3–4 miles away on finals.

**Object:** Three lights, later described as one yellowish light with two white lights; they moved upward, formed rectangles, drifted northward, then northeast, and gradually faded. No cloud was visible.

**Tactics:** The lights appeared to move away, with one larger light seeming more stationary while the others shifted; one point described as a shaft from two white lights angling down.

**Note:** Frame also observed the lights from the control tower balcony and later checked with Wellington ATC, which reported five radar targets in the Clarence area, though apparently unrelated to the Woodbourne sighting.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** W/O Uffindell 和 Mr Frame，1978年12月20/21日夜间在 Woodbourne 机场值勤。

**目击经过：** 约2350时，Uffindell 看到 Woodbourne 附近有三道灯光，起初以为是一架 Bristol Freighter 正在从3到4英里外进场。

**物体：** 三个灯光，后来描述为一黄两白；它们先上升，形成矩形，随后向北移动，再逐渐转向东北并慢慢消失。天空无云。

**轨迹/行为：** 这些灯光似乎在远离，其中较大的灯较为静止，另外两道则移动；曾见两道白光以约40度角向东北方向延伸。

**备注：** Frame 也从塔台阳台观察到该现象，后向惠灵顿塔台查询；对方提到 Clarence 地区有五个雷达目标，但似乎与 Woodbourne 所见无关。

events.title: SAFE Argosy crew reports radar and visual light near Wellington and Christchurch
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Captain Powell and First Officer Pirie, crew of a SAFE Argosy flight from Woodbourne to Christchurch and then Dunedin.

**Sighting:** During the flight, Wellington ATC asked them to investigate a radar return near the Wellington River area; later Wellington Radar and the crew tracked a strong return/visual target.

**Object:** A very bright light, described as bright orb/pear-shaped/reddish tinged then white, appearing stationary visually but moving on radar; later another light like a Boeing flashing strobe followed the radar track.

**Tactics:** The contact appeared close at first, then passed behind and out of sight/radar, later reappearing as multiple fast radar blips near Christchurch.

**Note:** The page is a typed summary of an interview and includes operator commentary that some returns may have been affected by aircraft radar, bearings, or condensation.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** SAFE Argosy 运输机机组，Captain Powell 与第一副驾驶 Pirie，并有惠灵顿空管/雷达操作员参与。

**目击经过：** 该航班从 Woodbourne 飞往 Christchurch 再到 Dunedin，飞行中惠灵顿空管要求他们调查惠灵顿河一带的雷达回波；随后惠灵顿雷达与机组又跟踪到一个强回波/可见目标。

**物体：** 一个非常明亮的光点，被描述为明亮的球状/梨形，先略带红色后变白；肉眼看似静止，但在雷达上移动；之后又出现一个像波音闪光灯的光点，沿着雷达回波路径移动。

**动作/行为：** 该目标起初看似很近，随后从视线和雷达中消失，后来在 Christchurch 附近又出现多个快速雷达“点”。

**备注：** 这页是访谈摘要，且文中也提到雷达回波可能受飞机雷达、方位或冷凝影响。

events.title: Kaikoura–Wellington light/radar track diagram, 20–21 Dec 1978
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Aircraft crew and radar operators associated with the Kaikoura–Wellington incident.

**Sighting:** This page is a hand-annotated plot of tracks and bearings for the 20/21 Dec 1978 event, showing multiple observations over the Cook Strait/Kaikoura region.

**Object:** Several lights and radar targets are marked, with notes such as "3 lights on these brgs seen from 6th" and "radar target tracked".

**Tactics:** The diagram compares apparent tracks, bearings, and possible celestial explanations (e.g. Venus) against aircraft/radar paths.

**Note:** This is a supporting chart rather than a narrative report, but it clearly documents a specific sighting incident.
events.report_summary_zh:

events.title: RNZAF radar contacts and red light near Clarence River mouth
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** RNZAF radar personnel monitoring the Wellington area, with a visual confirmation by RNZAF staff.

**Sighting:** Multiple slow-speed radar contacts were tracked in the Clarence River mouth area between 1100Z and 1500Z on 19 Dec 1978.

**Object:** One contact was reportedly confirmed by a visual sighting of a red light.

**Tactics:** The memo requests investigative follow-up, including aircraft capable of reaching the area and conducting radar/visual searches, plus a patrol of the coastal area between Cape Campbell and Banks Peninsula.

**Note:** This page is a restricted operational message about an unidentified radar/visual incident, not a contactee account.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** RNZAF 雷达人员在惠灵顿区域值勤，并有 RNZAF 人员进行目视确认。

**目击：** 1978年12月19日 1100Z 至 1500Z 期间，在 Clarence River 口附近区域追踪到多个低速雷达目标。

**物体：** 其中一个目标据称被目视确认为一个红色灯光。

**行动：** 该电报要求进一步调查，包括派遣可抵达该区域的飞机进行雷达/目视搜索，并在 Cape Campbell 与 Banks Peninsula 之间海岸进行巡逻。

**注：** 此页是关于一次不明雷达/目视事件的受限作战电报，不是接触者叙述。

events.title: Three lights seen near RNZAF Base Woodbourne
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** The Orderly Officer and Duty Air Traffic Controller at RNZAF Base Woodbourne.

**Sighting:** At 2350 on 20/21 Dec 1978, they watched lights they first thought were a Bristol Freighter about 3–4 miles from the base, heading toward Wellington.

**Object:** Three lights; the middle light looked like a white beam pointing northward. The lights did not come closer and could not be heard or closely identified, even through binoculars.

**Tactics:** The lights appeared to move upward and around, with no nearby aircraft approach.

**Note:** The report states the lights were not seen again at closer range and no firm identification was made.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 新西兰皇家空军伍德伯恩基地（RNZAF Base Woodbourne）的值班军官和值班空中交通管制员。

**目击：** 1978年12月20/21日23:50，他们看到一组最初被认为是“布里斯托尔货机”的灯光，距离基地约3–4英里，方向朝惠灵顿。

**物体：** 三盏灯；中间那盏看起来像一束朝北指向的白色光束。灯光没有靠近，尽管使用双筒望远镜也无法清楚辨认，而且听不到声音。

**行为：** 灯光似乎向上并绕行移动，周围没有可见的飞机接近。

**注：** 报告称这些灯光未再靠近观察，也未能作出明确识别。

events.title: Woodbourne lights seen from Cook Strait bearing, with radar returns
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A Woodbourne observer, with follow-up from the Wellington Radar Controller.

**Sighting:** For about 50 minutes the witness watched lights moving in a non-rectangular pattern at random speed. The bearing from Woodbourne was about 080° (towards Cape Campbell). The lights at times seemed to “rush forward” and generally drifted northward before fading.

**Object:** A cluster of lights, including one bright orange light and about 10 less intense white lights; one white light periodically appeared to beam downward.

**Tactics:** The observer used binoculars, which did not show any enlargement or close detail, suggesting the lights were at considerable distance.

**Note:** The report remarks that Wellington SRE/radar was painting five targets in the Clarence area, but no radar returns were noted in Cook Strait, making a direct link uncertain.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** Woodbourne 的一名观察员，以及后续提供雷达信息的 Wellington 雷达管制员。

**目击经过：** 约 50 分钟内，目击者看到一组灯光以非矩形轨迹、随机速度移动。自 Woodbourne 看到的方位约为 080°（朝向 Cape Campbell）。这些灯光有时似乎会“猛然向前冲”，总体上则向北漂移后逐渐消失。

**物体：** 一团灯光，包括一个明亮的橙色灯和约 10 个较弱的白色灯；其中一盏白灯还会周期性地向下发出光束。

**手法：** 目击者使用双筒望远镜观察，但没有看到明显放大或接近的细节，说明目标距离相当远。

**备注：** 报告指出 Wellington SRE/雷达在 Clarence 地区曾显示 5 个目标，但在 Cook Strait 未见对应回波，因此两者是否相关并不确定。

events.title: Kaikoura lights/radar-tracking diagram
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Map/annex for the 20/21 Dec 1978 Kaikoura incident, reflecting observations by flight crew and radar operators.

**Sighting:** The sketch plots multiple events along the northeast South Island coast, with several time marks and tracks showing a sequence of observed lights and radar returns through the night.

**Object:** Unidentified lights/returns that were said to move, hover, and be tracked by radar; some notes say the lights were observed from different positions and that radar returns “tracked” them.

**Tactics:** The diagram suggests the object(s) were followed along a route from the Marlborough/Kaikoura area, with repeated position updates and changing headings.

**Note:** This page is an annotated annex to a report, summarizing the well-known Kaikoura sightings rather than giving a full narrative report.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 这是一张1978年12月20/21日凯库拉事件的附页示意图，反映了机组人员和雷达操作员的观测。

**目击：** 草图沿着南岛东北海岸标出多起事件，包含多个时间点和轨迹，显示整夜持续出现的灯光和雷达回波。

**物体：** 未明灯光/回波，据称会移动、悬停，并被雷达追踪；旁注写明灯光可从不同位置观察到，雷达回波会“追踪”到它们。

**战术：** 示意图显示物体沿马尔堡/凯库拉一带被跟踪，伴随多次位置更新和航向变化。

**注：** 这页是报告附录的注释图，概述了著名的凯库拉目击事件，而不是完整叙述。
